import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Get species labels from training data
species_list = sorted(train["species"].unique())
species_mapping = {species: i for i, species in enumerate(species_list)}
labels = list(range(len(species_list)))

# Prepare base features (192 columns: 64 margin + 64 shape + 64 texture)
base_columns = (
    [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
    + [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
    + [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
)

X_train_raw = train[base_columns].values
X_test_raw = test[base_columns].values
y_train = train["species"].map(species_mapping).values
train_ids = train["id"].values
test_ids = test["id"].values

# Create hold-out validation set (20%)
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train ensemble of 10 models with diverse RF configurations
print("Training Random Forest ensemble with diverse configurations...")
models = []
val_loglosses = []

rf_configs = [
    {
        "n_estimators": 200,
        "max_depth": 20,
        "min_samples_split": 5,
        "min_samples_leaf": 2,
        "max_features": "sqrt",
    },
    {
        "n_estimators": 400,
        "max_depth": 40,
        "min_samples_split": 3,
        "min_samples_leaf": 1,
        "max_features": "sqrt",
    },
    {
        "n_estimators": 300,
        "max_depth": 50,
        "min_samples_split": 10,
        "min_samples_leaf": 4,
        "max_features": "log2",
    },
    {
        "n_estimators": 500,
        "max_depth": 15,
        "min_samples_split": 20,
        "min_samples_leaf": 8,
        "max_features": None,
    },
    {
        "n_estimators": 250,
        "max_depth": 35,
        "min_samples_split": 5,
        "min_samples_leaf": 2,
        "max_features": "sqrt",
    },
    {
        "n_estimators": 350,
        "max_depth": 25,
        "min_samples_split": 7,
        "min_samples_leaf": 3,
        "max_features": "log2",
    },
    {
        "n_estimators": 450,
        "max_depth": 30,
        "min_samples_split": 4,
        "min_samples_leaf": 1,
        "max_features": "sqrt",
    },
    {
        "n_estimators": 150,
        "max_depth": 10,
        "min_samples_split": 15,
        "min_samples_leaf": 5,
        "max_features": None,
    },
    {
        "n_estimators": 600,
        "max_depth": 45,
        "min_samples_split": 2,
        "min_samples_leaf": 1,
        "max_features": "sqrt",
    },
    {
        "n_estimators": 320,
        "max_depth": 28,
        "min_samples_split": 8,
        "min_samples_leaf": 3,
        "max_features": "log2",
    },
]

for i, config in enumerate(rf_configs):
    model = RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=config["n_estimators"],
        max_depth=config["max_depth"],
        random_state=42 + i,
        n_jobs=-1,
        class_weight="balanced",
        min_samples_split=config["min_samples_split"],
        min_samples_leaf=config["min_samples_leaf"],
        max_features=config["max_features"],
    )
    calibrated = CalibratedClassifierCV(model, cv=3, method="isotonic")
    calibrated.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)
    models.append(calibrated)

    # Validate each model on hold-out set
    val_probs = calibrated.predict_proba(X_val)
    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    val_ll = log_loss(y_val, val_probs_clipped, labels=labels)
    val_loglosses.append(val_ll)
    print(f"  RF Model {i+1} val logloss: {val_ll:.6f}")

# Use all models without aggressive filtering
print(f"\nUsing all {len(models)} models for ensemble")

# Compute weights from VALIDATION logloss for all models
weights = np.array([1.0 / ll for ll in val_loglosses])
weights = weights / np.sum(weights)
print(f"Validation-based weights (normalized): {weights}")

# Validate on hold-out set with proper validation-based weights
print("Computing weighted ensemble validation logloss on hold-out set...")
val_probs = np.average(
    [model.predict_proba(X_val) for model in models], axis=0, weights=weights
)
val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
logloss_val = log_loss(y_val, val_probs_clipped, labels=labels)
print(f"Validation logloss: {logloss_val:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Generating test predictions...")
test_probs = np.average(
    [model.predict_proba(X_test_raw) for model in models], axis=0, weights=weights
)
test_probs_clipped = np.clip(test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Create submission - use sample_submission as template for format
submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission.iloc[:, 1:] = test_probs_clipped
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Validation logloss metric: {logloss_val:.6f}")
